missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Линия' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Эта' points at it and 'прямая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, intensified by 'совершенно'. A clean description.

Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Линии' is the feminine genitive after 'нет', and 'красной' agrees in the genitive. 'На карте' is prepositional. A model for the genitive of -ия nouns.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Линии' is the dative form after 'к', showing direction toward. 'Метро' is an indeclinable modifier. A useful transit-related motion phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of path. 'Линией' is the instrumental marking the route along which the border runs. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A clean instrumental example.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Линии' is the prepositional form after 'на', marking location. 'Жёлтой' agrees in the feminine prepositional. A practical platform-safety phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Линии' is the inanimate accusative plural of 'рисуют', matching the nominative plural. 'Красивые' agrees in the plural. A natural classroom sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Линий' is the genitive plural after 'много', the zero-ending form for -ия nouns. 'Тонких' agrees, and 'на странице' is prepositional. A core quantity pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Линии' is the nominative plural subject of 'пересекаются'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'в центре' is prepositional. A clear geometric statement.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Линии' is the dative after 'по', marking the route. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine dative, and 'идёт' describes the movement. A useful transit phrase.
